pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway (east1). Threshold breached: 5m error-rate = 12.3% (>5%). Pager: oncall-sre group. PD: https://pd.example/r/INC12345
jen (oncall): seeing the alert, jumping in. what's the impact on customer traffic?
tina_sre: looking at traces now. east1 pod pool showing 502s from model-proxy -> downstream runtime. Errors spike coincides with a recent config rollout ~10m ago (deploy id abc123).
michael_prodeng: rolled a small config to change keepalive timeout to 30s a few mins before the spike, tagging @tina_sre for context.
jen (oncall): ok please snapshot logs and hold any more deploys. i'll ack the pager and start mitigation.
jen (oncall): /ack ACKED (reason: investigating) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deployment abc123 -> status: successful at 1987654300. Change: keepalive=30s, max_conns=120.
jen (oncall): @tina_sre can you drop a grep of the upstream 502s? paste short snippet.
tina_sre: paste_start
[2026-03-14T02:45:10Z] infer-proxy east1-3 -> runtime-45 502 BAD_GATEWAY: upstream read timeout
[2026-03-14T02:45:11Z] infer-proxy east1-4 -> runtime-46 502 upstream reset
[2026-03-14T02:45:12Z] infer-proxy east1-2 -> runtime-47 502 UNHANDLED_RESPONSE
paste_end
jen (oncall): looks like persistent upstream timeouts. rolling back keepalive config to previous value while we validate.
michael_prodeng: rolling rollback now: `kubectl set env deploy/infer-proxy KEEPALIVE=60 --record`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for deployment abc123 -> rollout id r-1987655000.
tina_sre: scaling up runtime pool temporarily (adding 4 nodes) to relieve pressure. command: `infractl scale runtime east1 --add 4`
jen (oncall): routing policy: divert 20% of traffic to fallback model variant in us-central to reduce pressure on east1. will monitor error rate.
oliver_cs: any immediate customer-facing impact? are we seeing dropped requests?
tina_sre: some requests failed with 502s and retries are causing increased latencies. CS: low-severity impact for a subset of sessions in eu/east region.
jen (oncall): putting a short post to status page: "Partial service degradation affecting inference calls in east1; mitigations underway."
jen (oncall): status page draft: `https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC12345` — please +1 before posting.
michael_prodeng: metrics: 5xx down from 12.3% -> 4.7% after rollback + scale (10min). latency p95 improved.
jen (oncall): good. keep monitoring for 30m, do not reapply abc123 until root cause fully understood. create a follow-up incident channel for RCA.
tina_sre: collecting heap, file descriptors, and proxy conn stats, uploading to debug bucket s3://redwood-debug/inc12345/
jen (oncall): assign next steps: @tina_sre investigate why keepalive change triggered upstream resets; @michael_prodeng produce a revert plan and gating for future keepalive changes; @oliver_cs draft customer comms for enterprise customers impacted.
oliver_cs: on it, will ping the top 3 affected accounts with current status and expected resolution ETA 30-45m.
jen (oncall): acked handoff in 20m to follow-up shift. If the error rate climbs above 8% re-escalate paging policy.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed r-1987655000 -> success at 1987655600.
tina_sre: confirming logs after rollback: last 15m sample shows <1% 5xx from east1 proxies.
jen (oncall): closing page? hold for 30m observation window. leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
michael_prodeng: added a quick guard in CI to block keepalive < 40s without infra signoff.
jen (oncall): good. please add timeline entries to incident doc later: root alert -> 1987654321, rollback start -> 1987655000, rollback complete -> 1987655600.
tina_sre: noted. postmortem channel: #inc-12345-rca will be created after stabilization.
oliver_cs: customer messages sent for affected customers. no escalations yet.
jen (oncall): thanks everyone. closing active mitigation. will update when RCA draft is ready. :thumbsup:
